page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, set in italic with roman capitals for the opening words of each sentence. No running head or page number. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side on the right, not transcribed. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p:
Æquiparet PIETATE laudes:
Annisque crescat post venientibus
Fauente semper NUMINE clarior,
Plebesque subiectas amicis
Imperiis moderetur usque.

Ductus Marinæ sic THETIDOS PUER
CHIRONIS olim PHILLYRII manu
Prudente regnatas per urbes
IUSTITIAM coluisse fertur:

VIRTUTE monstras, quâ renidens
Anteuenis FRIDERICE PRINCEPS
Annos viriles. Quem iuvenum choros
Inter decentes nobilium stupet

page.notes: Faint show-through of the reverse side is visible on the right margin and was left out. The verse is printed as continuous lines; the line breaks are kept inside each paragraph. No stanza numbers or running head are printed. The line "Frenasse," has a comma after the final letter as printed.
